Game Overview

In Flappy Dragons, the core idea is straightforward: test your reflexes in Flappy Dragons, where you navigate a dragon through tricky levels filled with obstacles. With intuitive tap controls and stunning visuals, dodge challenges like towering trees and collect coins to enhance your journey. The game’s escalating difficulty ensures endless fun and immersion.
